card: setup.site (js/content-setup.js): which of the planet's two landing sites the lander goes down on
notes: The landing site is a card now, after the name and just before the lander is loaded. The planet must read as any of the three (water, green, barren): if one picture cannot, paint a ~water, ~green and ~barren set by planet kind and say so in docs/officer-art-sync.md. Until it lands the card borrows arrive_name.
